rules.name: normative_preflight_before_geometry
rules.requirement: Identify the drawing domain, use case, delivery stage, applicable standards and authority order before creating any production geometry.
rules.failureCause: Geometry-first generation allows convenient defaults to become hidden design decisions before the governing discipline has been selected.
rules.prevention: Freeze a drawing requirement contract and execute the cross-domain normative gate as stage zero; failure prohibits geometry compilation and artifact exposure.

rules.name: source_authority_is_non_compensatory
rules.requirement: Standards and approved engineering evidence outrank preferences and references; reference CAD, images and inferred defaults may supply context but may not override a higher-authority fact.
rules.failureCause: A low-authority visual or default parameter can otherwise drive both the geometry and the check that approves it, creating a self-confirming error.
rules.prevention: Validate the source-kind order, retain explicit conflicts, bind every hard requirement to controlled evidence and reject reference-image dimensional authority.

rules.name: domain_rule_pack_and_object_proof
rules.requirement: After normative preflight, load the selected domain rule pack and prove each critical object against its semantic, mathematical, relational, drafting and stage-specific constraints before output.
rules.failureCause: Counting entities or checking only visual appearance does not prove that an object has the correct engineering purpose or relation to neighbouring objects.
rules.prevention: Use ordered semantic objects, backward dependencies, per-object constraints, domain QA, whole-drawing comparison and host save/reopen evidence; any hard failure blocks release.

rules.name: high_priority_rules_require_executable_closure
rules.requirement: Every high-priority normative rule must have a contract/schema field, generation constraint, independent QA gate and negative regression test.
rules.failureCause: A prose-only rule can be cited while the generator and validator continue to permit the prohibited geometry.
rules.prevention: Treat any missing schema-generation-QA-test link as an unimplemented rule and block release until the four-part proof is complete.
